statement: Given an arbitrary angle \(\alpha\), compute \(\cos\alpha + \cos\!\left(\alpha+\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) + \cos\!\left(\alpha+\tfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)\) and \(\sin\alpha + \sin\!\left(\alpha+\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\right) + \sin\!\left(\alpha+\tfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)\). Generalize this result and justify your answer.
Draw the graphs of \(y = |x^2-1|\) and \(y = x + |x^2-1|\). Find the number of roots of \(x + |x^2-1| = k\) where \(k\) is a real constant.

Let \(P\) be a plane, \(A \in P\), \(O \notin P\). For each line in \(P\) through \(A\), let \(H\) be the foot of the perpendicular from \(O\). Find the locus \((c)\) of \(H\). Let \((C)\) be the oblique cone with apex \(O\) and base \((c)\). Prove that planes parallel to \(P\) or perpendicular to \(OA\) intersect \((C)\) in circles. Find a relation between angles \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) made by two symmetric planes with \((C)\).

Define the Fibonacci sequence by \(f_0=1\), \(f_1=1\), \(f_{n+2}=f_{n+1}+f_n\). Show that \(f_n = \dfrac{a^{n+1}-b^{n+1}}{\sqrt{5}}\), where \(a, b\) are real numbers with \(a+b=1\), \(ab=-1\), and \(a > b\).
